_comment: Every key the iOS app understands, with the shipped defaults spelled out. NOT the served file - ios-config.json is. Copy the lines you actually want to change; anything left out keeps the app's built-in behaviour. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the app.
_products: Optional. Absent = the identifiers the app shipped with, per slot. Only set these to move to a NEW price point, and only after the product exists and is Ready to Submit in App Store Connect - naming a product that is not there takes the paywall to its Unavailable state for everyone at once.
_keyboardPlusPricingExperiment: Keyboard Plus iOS only (SMS Plus ignores it). Off by default; see README-ios-config.md. Flip enabled to true only after both B products exist and are Ready to Submit in App Store Connect.
_smsPlusPricingExperiment: SMS Plus iOS only (Keyboard Plus ignores it). Off by default; decide both arms, create the weekly product, and complete every product's metadata before enabling.
